if (not isinstance(branch, str) or not BRANCH.fullmatch(branch) or ".." in branch
            or "//" in branch or branch.endswith(".lock")):
evidence.reason: The default_branch guard only rejects a whole branch string ending in .lock and never examines each slash-separated component. It therefore accepts Git-invalid refs such as release.lock/main (a component ends in .lock) and release/.hidden (a component begins with .), then stores them as default_ref origin/<branch>. This is an implementation defect in existing validation, not a new requirement.
